sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, currently top with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Sandbach's recent form shows a single loss most recently, but they remain the division's strongest outfit with seven wins, one draw, and two losses so far. Alsager sit bottom of the table with just 4 points and have won only once all season, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to bounce back after their last defeat.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, a crucial fixture as Stafford look to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, host Eccleshall in a mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth, 19 points) visit Wednesfield Community at home on Saturday, then face Brereton Social away on Wednesday evening — a potentially demanding double. Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir on Saturday. Barnton entertain Shawbury United, with both sides currently hovering in mid-table. Market Drayton Town host New Mills, while Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement-battle encounter. Crewe host Allscott Heath, and Brereton Social face Widnes Town at home on Saturday before the Wednesday fixture against Wolverhampton Casuals.
